name: Telstra
summary: Australia's largest telco. Consumer internet was run under the BigPond brand from 1997 until ~2015 (TELSTRA CORPORATION LIMITED, ACN 051 775 556).

events.details: Telecom operations split from the Postmaster-General's Department (est. 1 Jan 1901 at Federation, running postal + telephone + telegraph nationally); disaggregated into the Australian Telecommunications Commission (Telecom Australia) and the Australian Postal Commission (Australia Post). The PMG itself was abolished Dec 1975.
Established as Australian Telecommunications Commission (Telecom Australia); renamed Telstra 1993/95.
